title: Giving Back - Volunteering at a Credit-Counseling Nonprofit
content: For years now, I've volunteered with a local nonprofit credit-counseling group - they help families get to financial stability through counseling and education. [pause] Here's what struck me: I spent my days at the firm thinking about portfolios and asset allocation for people who have money to invest. But millions of families are just trying to get to the starting line - dealing with debt, building that first emergency fund, learning the basics no one ever taught them. Sitting across a folding table from someone working through a pile of bills keeps me grounded. All the sophisticated finance stuff doesn't mean much if people can't first get on solid footing.
follow_up: What I love about that work is that it's not about giving people fish - it's about teaching them to fish. Financial literacy is freedom. When someone understands how money works, they can make their own good decisions. That's real empowerment.
